name: Climate
summary: The current shelf separates global observation, seasonal forecasting, national transportation-risk synthesis, and emissions-accounting methods. It supports climate conditions and dependency analysis, while local hazards, losses, adaptation, and resilience still require named regional and asset records.
watch_questions: How do ENSO and annual climate observations connect to regional water, agriculture, insurance, aviation, mobility, and power records?
Which named transportation assets have adopted new design, maintenance, operating, or capital decisions in response to climate evidence?
Where do EPA inventory scope, GHGRP thresholds, reporting years, and facility records change an emissions conclusion?
